collectionNotes: Repository tracked-file counts were computed from the exact PR base commit Git tree using the recursive Git Trees API; all 12 responses reported truncated=false.
Change commit is the merged PR commit. Historical changed paths are evidence only and are not treated as the complete impact ground truth.
No target repository code has been executed. Snapshot archives and content fingerprints have not yet been collected.
Each case requires two independent blinded reviewers and adjudication where needed before it can enter manifest.json.

The first large-project candidate batch was adjusted after exact base-tree counting: VS Code has 19,119 tracked files and is therefore medium under the strict >20,000 large threshold; Home Assistant Core (30,403 tracked files at its PR base) replaces it in the large cohort.
VS Code is retained as a medium-size reserve candidate (19,119 tracked files) and is excluded from the 12-repository first batch so the required 4/4/4 strata remain balanced.

An additional 24 merged pull-request candidates were identified across the same 12 repositories. Their PR metadata, exact base/merge SHAs, changed-file counts, changed paths, and license file availability at each exact base SHA were checked. These remain candidate evidence only, not independently adjudicated gold labels.

change.title: Fix dispatcher option being ignored
change.candidateRequest: Correct the request option handling so fetch-only dispatcher options are preserved when creating and sending requests.

change.title: Drop end of life Python versions
change.candidateRequest: Raise the minimum supported Python version and align package metadata, CI, type-checker configuration, and tests with the new support policy.

change.title: SupressNotFound must not mutate request route context
change.candidateRequest: Prevent the not-found suppression middleware from mutating a live request route context, preserving mounted-router parameters and middleware behavior.

change.title: Match filename-only regexes against basenames
change.candidateRequest: Optimize filename-only regular-expression matching so eligible patterns are evaluated against the basename without changing matching semantics.

change.title: Fix Decimal JSON Schema patterns accepting bare zero
change.candidateRequest: Correct generated Decimal JSON Schema patterns when no whole-number digits are permitted, keeping schema acceptance aligned with runtime validation.

change.title: Set req.route on the node adapter like Express
change.candidateRequest: Expose route-template metadata on the Node adapter request object consistently with the Express adapter, including route methods and global prefixes.

change.title: Add MigrationFailed event
change.candidateRequest: Introduce a MigrationFailed event and dispatch it when a database migration throws, preserving existing migration lifecycle behavior.

change.title: Avoid premature overflow converting durations to microseconds
change.candidateRequest: Avoid intermediate nanosecond overflow when converting large Duration values to microseconds while preserving exact conversion behavior.

change.title: Close underlying connection when SPDY upgrade fails
change.candidateRequest: Ensure the raw connection is closed when a streaming SPDY upgrade fails, while retaining the response error handling behavior.

change.title: Release Python GIL during physical-device listing and context creation
change.candidateRequest: Release the Python GIL around synchronous C++ device discovery and context creation so unrelated Python threads are not blocked.

change.title: Start a root span for each provisioning job
change.candidateRequest: Create a root tracing span for each provisioning job and wire the tracer into the concurrent job driver.

change.title: Forget disabled UniFi entities when their registry entry is removed
change.candidateRequest: Ensure disabled UniFi entities are removed from the integration's entity state when their registry entry is deleted, consistently across entity loading and sensor handling.

change.title: Retain full Copilot shell output through terminal subscriptions
change.candidateRequest: Preserve complete non-PTY agent shell output through subscription-backed terminal resources so users can inspect the full command output.

change.title: Preserve caller stack for schema validation errors
change.candidateRequest: Preserve the original caller stack when schema validation fails, while keeping the validation error contract consistent.

change.title: Fix progress callbacks for empty request and response bodies
change.candidateRequest: Ensure progress callbacks behave consistently for empty request and response bodies, including stream handling and browser tests.

change.title: Update project to use uv for dependency management
change.candidateRequest: Migrate the project's dependency and development workflow to uv, keeping build, documentation, publishing, pre-commit, and CI configuration aligned.

change.title: remove previously deprecated code
change.candidateRequest: Remove the previously deprecated public API and update package exports and release notes to reflect the removal.

change.title: middleware: preserve status after empty ReadFrom
change.candidateRequest: Preserve the response status when the wrapped writer receives an empty ReadFrom call, including the expected middleware writer behavior.

change.title: middleware: parse quoted ContentCharset media parameters
change.candidateRequest: Parse quoted charset values in Content-Type media parameters without changing middleware behavior for valid unquoted values.

change.title: ignore: respect linked worktree excludes without requiring Git
change.candidateRequest: Respect exclude rules associated with linked worktrees during ignore matching without invoking Git commands from the scanned target project.

change.title: ignore: reuse incremental matchers for directories without rules
change.candidateRequest: Reuse incremental ignore matchers for directories without local rules while preserving parent-rule matching semantics.

change.title: Support list and DecimalTuple inputs for Decimal
change.candidateRequest: Extend Decimal input conversion to support list and DecimalTuple representations, keeping documented conversions and runtime validation consistent.

change.title: Change the arguments schema for validate_call
change.candidateRequest: Update the generated arguments schema for validate_call and keep core validation, JSON Schema generation, error types, and public documentation consistent.

change.title: roll back modules on failed lazy load
change.candidateRequest: Ensure module discovery and container state are rolled back consistently when a lazy module load fails, including scanner and loader behavior.

change.title: keep the fields of grouped item errors in parse array pipe
change.candidateRequest: Preserve item-level validation fields in grouped errors emitted by ParseArrayPipe, maintaining the observable error contract and associated tests.

change.title: Add origin() to Uri class
change.candidateRequest: Expose an origin() accessor on the URI value object and keep package metadata and URI tests aligned with the public API.

change.title: Include identical BelongsToMany resources once in JSON:API compound documents
change.candidateRequest: Deduplicate identical BelongsToMany resources in JSON:API compound documents while preserving lazy relationship resolution and serialization behavior.

change.title: OpenTelemetry semantic conventions setting enables neither convention
change.candidateRequest: Correct the management observation convention selection so enabling OpenTelemetry conventions activates the intended semantic convention and its tests.

change.title: PushGatewayTaskScheduler shutdown on context close
change.candidateRequest: Ensure the PushGateway task scheduler shuts down correctly when the application context closes, preserving lifecycle cleanup semantics.

change.title: Enforce ResourceSlice object size budget
change.candidateRequest: Document and enforce the ResourceSlice object size budget, including validation and integration coverage for the API resource.

change.title: Decorate Service and PVC objects on storage decode
change.candidateRequest: Apply the storage decode decoration consistently to Service and PersistentVolumeClaim objects, including generic registry integration and storage tests.

change.title: Optimize CheckpointReader HasTensor lookup
change.candidateRequest: Use the initialized in-memory shape map for HasTensor lookups and align Python binding lock behavior with the optimized reader path.

change.title: Skip UTF-8 BOM when make_csv_dataset reads column names
change.candidateRequest: Ignore a UTF-8 byte order mark when make_csv_dataset parses CSV column names, and preserve the behavior with a focused data-loading regression test.

change.title: Annotation permission mappings for Zanzana
change.candidateRequest: Add annotation permission mappings to the authorization model and keep tuple translation, legacy permission parity, and authorization tests consistent.

change.title: Split folder has-rules label into alert and recording rule labels
change.candidateRequest: Separate folder labels for alert rules and recording rules, updating synchronization, service behavior, persistence, and related tests.

change.title: Prohibit Nest thermostat temperature changes in Eco mode
change.candidateRequest: Prevent temperature changes while the Nest thermostat is in Eco mode, keeping integration behavior and its climate tests aligned.

change.title: Add UniFi IPS engine update entity
change.candidateRequest: Add a UniFi IPS engine update entity and keep integration strings, update behavior, snapshots, and tests consistent.
